1.w: A name to be chosen [is] greater than wealth; favor is better than silver and gold.

2.w: The rich and the poor meet together; the maker of them all [is] YHWH.

3.w: A prudent one sees evil and hides himself, and the simple ones pass on and they are fined.

4.w: The result of humility [and] the fear of YHWH, [is] wealth and honor and life.

5.w: Thorns [and] snares [are] in the way of the crooked; one guarding his soul will be far from them.

6.w: Train up a child according to the mouth of his way, and when he grows old, he will not turn aside from it.

7.w: A rich one rules over the poor, and one borrowing [is] a servant to the man lending.

8.w: The one sowing injustice will reap trouble, and the rod of his anger will come to an end.

9.w: The one good of eye—he will be blessed, for he gives from his bread to the lowly one.

10.w: Drive out the one mocking, and quarreling will go out, and strife and shame will cease.

11.w: One loving a pure heart, [with] favor on his lips, the king [is] his friend.

12.w: The eyes of YHWH guard knowledge, and He twists the words of a treacherous one.

13.w: A lazy one says, “A lion is outside! In the midst of the open areas I will be killed!”

14.w: The mouth of strange women [is] a deep pit; the abhorred of YHWH will fall there.

15.w: Foolishness [is] bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

16.w: The one oppressing the poor, to increase for himself, giving to a rich one, surely [is] unto poverty.

17.w: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise ones, and set your heart to my knowledge;

18.w: for [it is] pleasant when you guard them in your belly; they are established together upon your lips.

19.w: For your trust to be in YHWH, I have caused you to know this day—even you.

20.w: Have I not written to you thirty sayings of counsels and knowledge,

21.w: to make you know the truth of the words of faithfulness, to return words of faithfulness to those sending you?

22.w: You must not rob a poor one because he [is] poor, and do not oppress an afflicted one at the gate.

23.w: For YHWH will fight their fight, and will rob the soul of those robbing them.

24.w: Do not make friends with an owner of anger, and with a man of rage do not go in,

25.w: lest you learn his ways and receive a snare for your soul.

26.w: Do not be among those striking hands in the pledging [for] loans.

27.w: If there is nothing unto you to repay, why should he take your bed from under you?

28.w: Do not remove a boundary of old, which your fathers have made.

29.w: Do you see a man quick in his work? Before the face of kings he will stand; he will not stand before the face of obscure ones.
